article.headline: Dylan McLean scores 19 as Alabama A&M defeats Florida A&M 77-66
article.description: — Dylan McLean's 19 points helped Alabama A&M defeat Florida A&M 77-66 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Dylan McLean scores 19 as Alabama A&M defeats Florida A&M 77-66

categories.description: Florida A&M Rattlers @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs

event.description: Florida A&M Rattlers @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs

keywords: Florida A&M Rattlers @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs
article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. -- — Dylan McLean's 19 points helped Alabama A&M defeat Florida A&M 77-66 on Monday night. McLean shot 5 of 10 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 7 from the free-throw line for the Bulldogs (10-18, 6-9 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Anthony Bryant added 13 points and five rebounds. Chad Moodie scored nine. Sterling Young led the Rattlers (12-14, 9-6) with 31 points off the bench. Milton Matthews added 19 points, six rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
